name: @fyeeme/pi-notify
description: Desktop notifications for pi — fires a native OSC 777 notification (Ghostty, iTerm2, WezTerm, rxvt-unicode) when the agent finishes and is waiting for input; the last assistant message, markdown-flattened and truncated to 200 characters, becomes the notif
